automations.title: Daily Brief Live Validation & Repair
automations.prompt:
Run the current-day Daily Generative AI Brief live validation and secondary recovery check for `gttome/Daily-AI-Brief` at 08:30 America/Chicago. Use ordinary scheduled ChatGPT capabilities plus connected GitHub/GitHub Actions/Pages. Do NOT invoke ChatGPT Work, Codex, paid APIs/services, overage, alternate accounts, or new credentials.

COORDINATION RULE: inspect durable current-day state and recent durable progress first. The hourly Publication Recovery supervisor is the primary recovery executor. If current-day durable state has advanced recently and is still progressing, do not launch a competing duplicate recovery; validate that progress and leave the primary recovery path in control. If there is no current-day progress after the expected start/recovery window, classify this as `scheduled_start_missed` or `recovery_stalled` and immediately take over from the first incomplete stage using the same no-rework rules. Never wait merely because another schedule was supposed to run.

If the edition is deployed or CLOSED, independently validate the actual live production result rather than trusting prior assertions. Verify at minimum: current date; exact six stories and 2/2/2 order; Agents for Everyone display label with stable internal category; exactly one Agent Skills story; all six professional story-specific images render fully and are not low-quality fallbacks/collages/placeholders; exactly 2 verified videos; exactly 2 source-diverse verified podcasts; current Watchlist counts/details and teaser parity; appropriate Professional Series mappings; homepage/dated/latest/archive parity; routes, navigation, feeds and required links; protected CI and exact-SHA Pages deployment evidence; ratings/sharing/privacy checks where governed by active contracts; completion evidence; and durable lifecycle status.

For every defect, classify the smallest invalidated stage. Repair only that stage and its deterministic dependents. Preserve accepted/locked image bytes, valid media receipts, editorial kernel, evidence packages, existing valid publication PR/branch, and all other unaffected checkpoints. A live-site defect must not trigger fresh editorial discovery unless current durable evidence proves the editorial stage itself invalid.

LIVING DOCUMENT RULE: `docs/operations/LIVING-SYSTEM-OPERATIONS.md` must remain synchronized with implemented system behavior. If this validation/recovery run identifies a new recurring failure, changes a recovery/validation responsibility, adds a permanent guard, or changes notifications/completion semantics, update the living document in the same hardening PR/change set when safe. If emergency scope prevents that, record the documentation debt for the first subsequent hardening/closure change.

Continue ordinary bounded repair through revalidation when safe. Do not bypass protected CI, lower image/media/editorial quality, replace required artifacts with placeholders/fallbacks, change sharing/access, touch the separate Sites Command Center, merge PR #117, or use Work/Codex/paid services/new credentials. If a safe repair is not possible within these constraints, preserve the last valid live edition/current stable state and record the exact blocker.

Record exact main/deployed SHA, lifecycle entry/final state, whether recent durable progress existed, missed-start/stall status, defects found, targeted repairs, checkpoints reused, workflow/PR/commit identifiers, revalidation results, whether the edition is durably CLOSED, and any living-document update made. Unknown values remain unavailable rather than inferred.
